findings.claim: Checkpoint (c) at plan.md:200 and the acceptance criterion at plan.md:215 both require `devai round status --round R-nnnn` to return `closed` for every round sealed with a PC. After the seals the literal command exits 5 with TASK_ROUND_INACTIVE (R-0003, and R-0017 before it). The only disposition so far is an Architect diagnostic plus a sensor-error triage entry (plan.md §Triagem, reports/CTG-0003-round-status-diagnostic.md). Maestro rule (12) in prompts/00-maestro.md:82-85 makes acceptance criteria immutable. Any change other than A1 must be a numbered addendum decided by the Owner, and the replaced criterion is recorded as not met, never as PASS. No such addendum or Owner decision exists, so the checkpoint blocks PASS, the commits and the CTG-0003 PR under the current prompt. The command's failure is not credited as PASS in this review.
findings.fix: An Architect writes a numbered addendum (e.g. contracts/CTG-0003-A3.6-round-status.md) that defines an equivalent verification for all 17 sealed rounds (R-0003…R-0016, R-0018, R-0019 plus R-0017). It must require: (a) exactly one line in each close-state.jsonl, byte-identical to the six-key serialization produced by appendCloseState, with round_id/status/closing_decision/phase_closure/merged_as matching the PC, record.md and record/derived/indexes/rounds.md; (b) a read-only reading of the governed lifecycle through the pinned runtime (governedRoundStatus or another verb that does not call roundTaskStatus) showing the closed location, recorded with argv, exit code and stdout sha256; (c) a negative control showing R-0020 still active; (d) the receipts of the 16 `round seal --write` runs from both the clone and the worktree, plus verify:state-index and verify:rounds-index. After a cross-family review PASS, the Owner accepts it in an AUTHORIZATION-*.md committed as a segregated Owner commit. The literal criterion stays recorded as not met / n/a in the R-0020 closure.json, never as pass, and the triage entry is kept. Only then repeat the delivery review.
